summary: Design competency-based curricula and assessments that produce measurable performance evidence. 5-day hands-on training for L&D and curriculum professionals.
lede: Competency-based curriculum design and assessment aligns learning programmes with defined competencies and evidence of learner performance. For curriculum designers, developers, and learning managers, the course addresses the task of turning occupational requirements into coherent learning and assessment plans. Participants practise competency mapping and backward design, create criterion-referenced assessments and rubrics, and apply moderation and quality-assurance processes to support consistent judgments.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who design, manage, or quality-assure learning programmes and need a structured, evidence-based approach to competency alignment and assessment. It suits both those working within formal education systems and those operating in corporate L&D, vocational training, or professional development contexts.
modules: Curriculum Integration, Reporting, and Continuous Improvement
prerequisites: This course is designed for professionals with at least one to two years of experience in instructional design, curriculum development, training delivery, or academic programme management. You should be comfortable working with learning outcomes or course objectives and have a basic familiarity with at least one instructional design model (such as ADDIE or SAM). No advanced technical skills, coding, or specialist software are required. Participants are encouraged to bring a current or recent curriculum project — even a partial one — to use as a working case throughout the five days. Access to a laptop for digital exercises and template completion is recommended but not mandatory; printed workbooks are provided.
